description:
Job Title: Internal Sales

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Location: Near Biggleswade, Bedfordshire
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Working Arrangement: 100% office-based
Salary: Up to 35,000 per annum + annual bonus of up to 1,000
Contract: Permanent Opportunity
Transport: Own transport essential due to the office location

Are you a proactive, commercially minded individual who enjoys building relationships, identifying sales opportunities and growing existing customer accounts?

Our client is a prestigious and well-established packaging organisation with an excellent reputation for quality, innovation and customer satisfaction. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit an Internal Sales Executive to join their friendly and supportive team on a permanent basis.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys the sales side of customer relationships, with a particular focus on developing an established client base of approximately 600 customers. Rather than focusing on processing orders and preparing quotations, the role is centred on proactive sales activity, building relationships with existing clients, introducing new products and identifying opportunities to increase revenue.

Please note: Due to the office location, candidates must have their own transport to travel to and from work.

The Role

As an Internal Sales Executive , you will play a key role in maximising sales opportunities across the existing customer base. You will proactively contact clients, develop relationships with key contacts, raise awareness of new products and identify opportunities to upsell and grow existing accounts.

This is a commercially focused role suited to someone who is confident speaking with customers, enjoys regular communication and is motivated by achieving sales results.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively contact existing customers to maintain and develop strong business relationships.
- Manage and develop relationships across an established client base of approximately 600 customers.
- Identify opportunities to upsell products and increase sales within existing accounts.
- Introduce customers to new products, product ranges and relevant business developments.
- Build relationships with additional contacts and decision-makers within customer organisations.
- Identify customer needs and understand how the company's products can add value to their business.
- Maintain regular contact with customers to keep the company front of mind and encourage repeat and additional business.
- Monitor customer activity and identify accounts with potential for further growth.
- Take a proactive approach to re-engaging with customers and developing opportunities that may otherwise be missed.
- Record customer interactions, sales activity and opportunities accurately on internal systems.
- Work closely with colleagues to share customer feedback, identify opportunities and support the wider sales function.
- Contribute towards sales targets and the overall growth of the business.

About You

We are looking for a confident, enthusiastic and commercially aware individual who enjoys speaking with customers and building lasting business relationships. You will be proactive in your approach, comfortable initiating conversations and motivated by identifying opportunities to generate additional sales.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in internal sales, telesales, account management, sales support or a similar commercially focused role.
- Confidence making outbound calls and proactively contacting existing customers.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- A natural ability to identify sales opportunities and promote additional products.
- A proactive, positive and results-driven attitude.
- The confidence to engage with different contacts within customer organisations.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage a large customer base effectively.
- Excellent attention to detail and accurate record-keeping.
- Good IT skills and the ability to learn new systems.
- The ability to work independently while contributing to a supportive team environment.
- Your own transport, essential due to the office location near Biggleswade.

Experience within the packaging industry would be beneficial but is not essential. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the right attitude, a genuine interest in sales and the drive to develop existing customer relationships.

What's on Offer?
- Basic salary of up to 35,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- Annual bonus of up to 1,000.
- Permanent position with a well-established and growing organisation.
- Monday to Friday working hours, 9:00am - 5:00pm.
- 100% office-based role near Biggleswade, Bedfordshire.
- The opportunity to develop and grow sales across an established customer base.
- A position focused on relationship development and sales growth, rather than order processing.
- A friendly, supportive team environment with genuine long-term career prospects.

Interested?

If you're a proactive sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing existing accounts and finding opportunities to grow revenue, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
The Role

Our client based in Shefford Bedfordshire are looking for a motivated, well-organised Internal Sales Executive to join our busy sales office. This is a genuinely split role: around 60% of your time will be spent on the phone and email growing sales and managing your own portfolio of existing, lapsed and new customers, and the remaining 40% will be spent keeping orders, quotes and customer service moving smoothly behind the scenes.

You will own a portfolio of accounts and be expected to grow it, while also working closely with our external sales team as their right hand on the admin side

Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Account Growth
- Own and grow an allocated portfolio of existing customers, creating clear targets for revenue, margin and account growth
- Build relationships with key decision makers and technical contacts, driving customer loyalty and repeat business
- Make regular, planned outbound calls and emails to existing, lapsed and prospective customers to uncover needs and generate orders
- Prospect and qualify new business opportunities through outbound activity
- Re-engage lapsed accounts and support customer retention
- Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across our product range
- Maintain accurate pipeline activity and customer data in the CRM
- Work towards agreed monthly and annual sales and activity targets

Sales Administration and Customer Service
- Process customer orders accurately and on time, making sure all details are captured correctly in our system
- Prepare and issue quotations based on customer requirements and company pricing guidelines, and follow up to convert them into orders
- Act as a first point of contact for day-to-day customer queries on stock, pricing, lead times and order status
- Investigate and resolve faults, returns, warranty claims, delivery problems and invoice discrepancies, keeping the customer informed throughout
- Support external sales representatives with their requests, including quotes, account follow-ups, pricing queries and order chasing
- Liaise with purchasing, warehouse, logistics and finance teams to ensure orders are fulfilled on time
- Monitor stock availability and proactively communicate delays or alternatives to customers
- Keep CRM records accurate and up to date

title: Nursery Sales Executive
description:
This is a rare opportunity to join an ambitious specialist nursery at the start of a significant period of investment and growth.

I am recruiting on behalf of an ambitious and extremely well-backed specialist tree nursery in Bedfordshire, which is undergoing an exciting transformation.

The ambition is to develop the nursery into one of the UK's leading suppliers of semi-mature trees and landscape products, supplying landscapers, developers and retailers across the country.

As part of that growth, I am looking to recruit a Nursery Sales Executive who can help to develop existing customer relationships, generate new opportunities and play a key role in the nursery's commercial development.

This is an opportunity to join a business at a formative stage of its journey and help shape how its commercial operation develops.

The Role

Working from the nursery in Bedfordshire, you will manage and develop relationships across a varied customer base, including landscapers, developers, contractors and retail customers.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing enquiries from initial contact through quotation, order and completed sale.
- Preparing commercial quotations and proactively following up opportunities.
- Providing customers with knowledgeable advice on trees, planting and aftercare.
- Working closely with the nursery operations team to ensure stock is selected, prepared and delivered to the required standard.
- Maintaining accurate sales information and working within appropriate company governance processes.
- Representing the nursery professionally during customer meetings, site visits and visits to the nursery.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic, commercially minded individual who enjoys building relationships and wants to contribute to the growth of a business.

You are likely to have:
- Previous experience within sales, account management or business development.
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
- Good commercial awareness and the confidence to identify new opportunities.
- A proactive approach to developing business and following up enquiries.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail.
- A genuine focus on customer service.
- A full UK driving licence.
- Previous experience within horticulture, landscaping, arboriculture or the nursery sector would be advantageous.

The Opportunity

What makes this position particularly interesting is the scale of ambition behind the business.

The nursery already has the foundations of an established operation but is now benefiting from the backing, investment and commercial opportunities associated with a significantly larger parent organisation. There is a clear strategy to professionalise and grow the business, broaden its customer base and establish it as a leading name within its market.

For the successful candidate, that creates the opportunity to join relatively early in the journey and have genuine influence over its development.

The package will include:
- A competitive salary, dependent on experience
- Car allowance
- Personalised targets and company bonus structure
- Benefits package
- Continued training and professional development
- If you are an accomplished salesperson already work within landscaping, horticulture or the nursery sector and are looking for an opportunity with significant growth potential, I would be very interested in speaking with you.

Interested? For an informal chat, please call Emily on (phone number removed), email (url removed) or message me on LinkedIn. Don't worry if your CV isn't up to date, just send what you have already, and we can sort the rest later.

You'll process customer orders, manage enquiries, resolve issues, and work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring prompt fulfilment.

- Resolve customer issues and complaints professionally, achieving positive outcomes.
- Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth order processing.
- Follow up quotations and proactively engage with customers.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, or internal sales role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
